items.t: Flooding at grounds forces cancellation of St. Lucie County 4-H Fall Festival
items.x: Flooding and more rain in the forecast led St. Lucie County 4-H to cancel its Nov. 7 festival over safety concerns.

items.t: Port St. Lucie man arrested after officers spot marijuana in plain view
items.x: What started as a domestic disturbance investigation ended with police seizing nearly 9 pounds of marijuana from a Port St. Lucie vehicle.

items.t: Port St. Lucie police: Traffic stop leads to nearly 9 pounds of marijuana seizure
items.x: A traffic stop near Southwest Rice Avenue and Southwest Chartwell Street led Port St. Lucie police to seize nearly 9 pounds of marijuana and $1,450.

items.t: Breast cancer patient to run New York City Marathon to change the future for her daughters
items.x: After beating breast cancer once before, Kristen Dugan is now facing a recurrence while training for the New York City Marathon and leading a West Palm Beach fundraising walk.

items.t: Riviera Beach breaks ground on new police complex on site of Barracuda Bay pool
items.x: Riviera Beach broke ground on a new police complex with an administration building, evidence warehouse and eight-lane firing range.

items.t: DHS: Nearly 4,200 arrested during 10-Day Texas immigration operation
items.x: DHS says nearly 4,200 immigrants living in the U.S. illegally were arrested during a 10-day Texas operation, with more than 60% having criminal histories.

items.t: Arbitrator awards family $3 million in wrongful death case involving Boca nursing home
items.x: An arbitrator found The Encore at Boca Raton 85% responsible in Patricia Batashoff’s 2023 death and awarded her family $2.55 million.

items.t: Miller Lite releasing 'Clinch Cans' filled with beer made during exact time Brewers won the World Series

items.t: Martin County man sentenced to 84 years in child pornography, voyeurism case
items.x: Daniel Clark Warren was sentenced to about 84 years in prison after being found guilty on 82 counts, including child pornography and video voyeurism.

items.t: Cuba welcomes home diplomat expelled from US after unusual altercation at the UN
